cwd.description: Optional cwd override for the supervised campaign front door.

objective.description: Bounded optimization objective for the campaign.

setupMode.description: How the front door should prepare the setup decision. autoplan is local and fast; prompt_vault_setup also requests the governed setup packet through the package-owned decision runner.

runMode.description: How far to execute the supervised campaign front door: plan only, run the first baseline, or enter a bounded loop.

planner.description: Planner backend. dspx_program can materialize a DSPx-generated DSPy planner assembly; with runDspxProgramGen=true, pi-autoresearch validates the generated DSPy output before using it as the local campaign plan while remaining the outer controller.

direction.description: Whether lower or higher metric values are better.

metricThreshold.description: Optional explicit success threshold for threshold-style metrics.

materializeDspxIntent.description: When planner=dspx_program, write the local DSPx intent artifact.

runDspxProgramGen.description: When planner=dspx_program, run the bounded local DSPx program-gen command and use its behavior_results.json as the campaign plan.

dspxIntentPath.description: Optional repo-relative or absolute DSPx intent path.

dspxOutdir.description: Optional repo-relative or absolute DSPx program-gen output dir.

dspxBehaviorPath.description: Optional DSPx behavior_results.json path for advisory setup input.

reconfigure.description: Append a new config segment even if one is already configured; direct campaign-start execution fails closed without this when the requested metric/benchmark differs from the active segment.

postureCommand.description: Optional posture command required before benchmark execution.

decisionGoal.description: When set, request governed next-hypothesis decisions in loop mode.

peerMode.description: Peer handoff policy after the bounded loop. launch_* returns an exact canonical peer tool call for explicit controller dispatch; pi-autoresearch does not auto-spawn peers.

mode.description: Use isolated git worktrees as the candidate lifecycle primitive.

keep.description: Keep policy after a promising run; no merge or promotion is automatic.

discard.description: Discard policy after a rejected run; receipts remain, and cleanup requires explicit operator confirmation.

rewind.description: Candidate rewind policy for worktree state. ASC rewind remains live session recovery, not candidate authority.

campaignGoalId.description: Optional package-local campaign goal id for foreground continuation.

campaignGoalIterationBudget.description: Total iteration budget across foreground campaign-goal segments.

campaignGoalWallClockMinutesBudget.description: Total wall-clock budget across foreground campaign-goal segments.

campaignGoalTokenBudget.description: Optional token-like budget ledger value across foreground segments.

campaignGoalAutoContinue.description: When true, keep the package-local campaign goal active after each foreground segment while budget remains so the opt-in session auto-continuation hook can send the next visible follow-up.

cwd.description: Optional cwd override for candidate intake planning.

action.description: Inspect a candidate worktree and prepare the exact measurement call.

candidateSource.description: Optional source for a visible candidate binding. candidate_peer_spawn means a visible isolated peer/worktree produced the candidate; manual means the controller supplied the candidate binding directly.

candidateWorktree.description: Candidate worktree/path to inspect. Defaults to cwd so /autoresearch bind current works.

candidateBaseRef.description: Controller-verified base ref for diff and later rewind planning.

description.description: Measurement description for the planned runtime run call.

action.description: Load a typed llama.cpp benchmark campaign manifest, either expand the exact 41/42/43 branch-lane matrix, plan/apply the fork workspace preparation, plan/apply one exact stage invocation, derive one exact AK-ready binding snapshot for an anchored task, or plan/apply one truthful next campaign-local stage step.

cwd.description: Optional cwd override for manifest loading, fork preparation, and stage execution binding.

manifestPath.description: Path to the checked campaign manifest JSON relative to cwd or absolute.

stage.description: Only for action=execute_stage. Select the exact workstation stage to bind.

buildId.description: Only for action=execute_stage. Exact manifest-listed build id to bind to the selected stage.

apply.description: For action=prepare_fork, action=execute_stage, or action=advance_campaign. When true, apply the selected fork/stage/next-step action instead of only printing the plan.

persistProjection.description: When true, explicitly write the derived campaign projection artifact even for non-apply plan/status calls. Mutating profiles only.

taskId.description: Only for action=build_ak_binding. Exact AK task id that this manifest campaign should reduce into a compact binding snapshot.

action.description: Inspect the bounded public campaign-control posture for one manifest-driven llama.cpp campaign, or plan/apply exactly one truthful next step without raw stage/build inputs.

cwd.description: Optional cwd override for manifest loading and public campaign-control actions.

manifestPath.description: Path to the checked campaign manifest JSON relative to cwd or absolute.

taskId.description: Optional exact AK task id for composing exact-task AK-binding context into the public control snapshot.

apply.description: Only for action=advance. When true, apply exactly one truthful next step instead of only planning it.

persistProjection.description: When true, explicitly write the derived campaign projection artifact even for non-apply status/advance plans. Mutating profiles only.

cwd.description: Optional cwd override for repo/problem inspection.

objective.description: Optimization objective to turn into a bounded campaign plan.

direction.description: Whether lower or higher metric values are better.

metricThreshold.description: Optional explicit success threshold for threshold-style metrics.

materializeDspxIntent.description: When planner=dspx_program, write the local DSPx intent artifact.

dspxIntentPath.description: Optional repo-relative or absolute DSPx intent path.

dspxOutdir.description: Optional repo-relative or absolute DSPx program-gen output dir.

dspxBehaviorPath.description: Optional repo-relative or absolute DSPx behavior_results.json path to read as evidence-only advisory setup input.

action.description: Inspect the current operator control overlay, set an explicit continue/rebaseline/finalize/stop decision, or apply an explicit campaign-goal pause/resume/complete control action.

cwd.description: Optional cwd override for control inspection.

decision.description: Explicit operator control decision for the current bounded runtime posture.

reason.description: Optional short reason for the selected control decision.

action.description: Inspect the current finalization plan state, refresh/reuse a plan, record approval, or materialize local review branches.

cwd.description: Optional cwd override for finalization actions.

reason.description: Optional short reason for approve/materialize actions.

maxIterations.description: Required maximum iterations for this bounded loop.

direction.description: Whether lower or higher metric values are better.

metricThreshold.description: Optional explicit success threshold when bootstrapping.

reconfigure.description: Append a new config receipt before the first loop run.

postureCommand.description: Optional posture command required to pass before each run.

decisionGoal.description: When set, request governed next-hypothesis decisions between runs.

peerMode.description: Peer handoff policy after the bounded loop. launch_* returns an exact canonical peer tool call for explicit controller dispatch; pi-autoresearch does not auto-spawn peers.

campaignGoalId.description: Optional package-local campaign goal id for foreground continuation.

campaignGoalIterationBudget.description: Total iteration budget across foreground campaign-goal segments.

campaignGoalWallClockMinutesBudget.description: Total wall-clock budget across foreground campaign-goal segments.

campaignGoalTokenBudget.description: Optional token-like budget ledger value across foreground segments.

campaignGoalAutoContinue.description: When true, keep the package-local campaign goal active after each foreground segment while budget remains so the opt-in session auto-continuation hook can send the next visible follow-up.

cwd.description: Optional cwd override for peer-assist planning.

lane.description: Peer-assist lane to plan. auto selects from current runtime state.

parentPeerTarget.description: Exact parent peer target/session id for intercom report-back.

cwd.description: Optional cwd override for foreground resume apply.

maxIterations.description: Required maximum iterations for this foreground resume apply.

cwd.description: Optional cwd override for the bounded runtime

description.description: Short description of what this bounded run is trying.

runKind.description: Run kind. Calibration runs update timing/noise interpretation but should not be treated as candidate improvements.

hypothesisId.description: Optional stable hypothesis identifier to bind this run into experiment lineage.

hypothesis.description: Optional hypothesis this run is testing.

interventionSummary.description: Optional short summary of the intervention or candidate being measured.

expectedPrimaryEffect.description: Optional expected effect on the primary metric before the run executes.

hypothesisTargetFiles.description: Optional files or paths that the hypothesis/intervention concerns.

experimentRisk.description: Optional risk or validity caveat for this experiment run.

candidateSource.description: Optional source for a visible candidate binding. candidate_peer_spawn means a visible isolated peer/worktree produced the candidate; manual means the controller supplied the candidate binding directly.

candidateWorktree.description: Optional visible candidate worktree/path being evaluated. This binds evidence only; pi-autoresearch does not spawn, merge, or promote the candidate.

candidateBranch.description: Optional candidate branch name or ref supplied by the visible candidate lane.

candidateBaseRef.description: Optional base ref the candidate was produced from.

candidateDiffSummary.description: Optional controller-verified summary of the candidate diff.

candidateFilesChanged.description: Optional controller-verified files changed by the candidate.

name.description: Campaign name. Required when bootstrapping the first config receipt or reconfiguring the bounded runtime.

metricName.description: Primary metric name. Required when bootstrapping the first config receipt or reconfiguring the bounded runtime.

metricUnit.description: Primary metric unit (defaults to empty string).

direction.description: Whether lower or higher metric values are better.

metricThreshold.description: Optional explicit success threshold. Lower metrics satisfy value<=threshold; higher metrics satisfy value>=threshold. Does not authorize external promotion.

benchmarkCommand.description: Benchmark command override. Defaults to the config receipt command or 'bash autoresearch.sh' when present.

anyOf.description: Pass null to disable checks for this run.

postureCommand.description: Optional machine/workstation posture command that must report safe posture before the benchmark starts.

reconfigure.description: Append a new config receipt before this run. Requires name + metricName and resets the current segment.

decisionGoal.description: When set, request a governed Prompt Vault next-hypothesis decision after the run using this bounded goal.

action.description: Setup action: plan only, apply config receipt only, or apply and run baseline.

metricName.description: Primary metric name parsed from METRIC name=value.

direction.description: Whether lower or higher metric values are better.

metricThreshold.description: Optional explicit success threshold for this metric contract.

reconfigure.description: Append a new config segment even if one is already configured.

benchmarkScript.description: Optional autoresearch.sh content to write before apply/baseline.

checksScript.description: Optional autoresearch.checks.sh content to write before apply/baseline.

action.description: Inspect status, build package-local closeout/evidence/Oracle-ready/learning/candidate-result packets, list adapter packet contracts, validate an adapter packet structurally, or request a governed setup/finalize Prompt Vault packet through the bounded runtime surface.

cwd.description: Optional cwd override for runtime reporting

outPath.description: Optional output path for action=oracle_evidence_export, action=learning_export, or action=candidate_result_export. Must be relative under cwd/.autoresearch; defaults are .autoresearch/oracle_evidence.json, .autoresearch/learning.json, and .autoresearch/candidate-result.json.

overwrite.description: Required as true for action=oracle_evidence_export, action=learning_export, or action=candidate_result_export when the target JSON file already exists.

archiveLabel.description: Optional archive label for candidate_inventory_cleanup_plan/apply. Defaults to a timestamp under cwd/.autoresearch/closed-candidates/.

operatorConfirmation.description: Required for candidate_inventory_cleanup_apply; must equal ARCHIVE STALE AUTORESEARCH CANDIDATES.

optimizationObjective.description: Required for action=setup. The bounded optimization objective for the setup packet.

packet.description: Required for action=validate_packet. The adapter packet object to validate structurally.

akTaskId.description: Optional AK task id reference for action=setup, or required exact task id for action=ak_evidence.

action.description: Inspect the supervised self-hosting contract, plan/apply the candidate worktree, run one bounded controller/candidate/evaluator wave, stream progress while that bounded wave runs, or record an explicit rollback after external controller rotation.

cwd.description: Optional cwd override for the supervised self-hosting campaign.

apply.description: For action=prepare_candidate or action=rollback. When true, apply the bounded worktree/rollback write instead of only planning it.

candidateTimeoutMs.description: Optional timeout in milliseconds for action=run or action=start_and_watch candidate subprocess execution.

suiteTimeoutMs.description: Optional timeout in milliseconds for each locked evaluator suite execution.

primaryMetricBaseline.description: Required for action=run or action=start_and_watch. Baseline metric value used by applicability classification.

primaryMetricCandidate.description: Required for action=run or action=start_and_watch. Candidate metric value used by applicability classification.

variantTargetProfileImproved.description: Optional explicit evidence that the declared variant target profile improved during this wave.

regressionPercent.description: Optional non-critical transfer regression percent to feed into applicability classification for this exact suite.

items.description: Explicit external approvals accepted by the supervised self-hosting contract.

approvedAt.description: Optional approval timestamp for promotion planning/apply.

promotedCandidateRef.description: Optional promoted candidate ref override for action=run or action=start_and_watch when promotion planning/apply should not default to the candidate HEAD.

promotionStatus.description: Optional promotion-record status for action=run or action=start_and_watch when a default-promotion candidate should also plan/apply the external promotion record.

promotionApply.description: Only for action=run or action=start_and_watch. When true, write the promotion record after a default-promotion classification instead of only planning it.

rollbackReason.description: Required for action=rollback. Short explicit reason for the external rollback record.

action.description: Inspect or plan a bounded workstation vLLM autoresearch campaign cockpit for multi-matrix speed optimization.

modelPath.description: Local model path to optimize, usually under /data/vllm/hf-cache.

knowledgeBase.description: Path to Blackwell knowledge base, absolute or relative to cwd.

matrixAxes.description: Optional matrix axes for planning; each key is an axis and each value is the list of values.
